title: The Late Weather
author: Noor Sandoval
blurb: Felix Fairweather, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, has spent fifteen years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
